name: AT-rich interaction domain 5B

function.text: ARID5B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 5B. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
